findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_website_preview, audit_agent_readiness, extract_page_markdown, feed_parse, link_map, summarize · Private data: audit_website_preview, audit_agent_readiness, extract_page_markdown, extract_structured_data, feed_parse, link_map, summarize · Public sink: audit_website_preview, extract_page_markdown, extract_structured_data, feed_parse, link_map, summarize.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_website_preview, audit_agent_readiness, extract_page_markdown, feed_parse, link_map, summarize · Private data: audit_website_preview, audit_agent_readiness, extract_page_markdown, extract_structured_data, feed_parse, link_map, summarize · Public sink: audit_website_preview, extract_page_markdown, extract_structured_data, feed_parse, link_map, summarize

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_website_preview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
